image_id_rule: extensionless test-image stem; preserve exact string identity and one row per required ID
overall_rule: mean leaderboard metric position when available; otherwise -PLCC
limits: Absolute correlations discard direction; reversed ordering can share the same magnitudes
Correlations are cohort statistics, not a per-image score
Constant or non-finite inputs can yield NaN; no measured result is retained
Leaderboard positions depend on supplied leaderboard rows and selected metrics
